profile.headline: Front-End/Full-Stack Developer | Expert in React.js, React Native, and Next.js, Node.js, Nest.js, | Proven Track Record in Scalable Application Design and Performance Optimization
profile.summary:
As a results-driven Front-End/Full-Stack Developer, I bring over 8 years of experience designing and implementing robust, scalable solutions that drive business impact. With expertise in React.js, Node.js, React Native, Next.js, and related frameworks, I specialize in crafting high-performance, user-centric applications.

In my role at SAIC, I optimized mission-critical DoD applications, leading development efforts with cutting-edge tools and mentoring teams to achieve operational excellence. My ability to bridge front-end and back-end technologies has allowed me to deliver seamless, integrated solutions that enhance user experiences and streamline workflows.

I thrive in collaborative environments, leveraging strong communication skills to align cross-functional teams and deliver quantifiable results. Whether it’s improving application performance, implementing innovative solutions, or leading high-stakes projects, I am committed to driving success for both teams and organizations.

Let's connect and discuss how I can bring my expertise to your team!

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developing mobile and web experiences for Caesars Sportsbook using React Native, React.js, and TypeScript. 
- Building real-time sportsbook features with WebSockets, including live odds and game updates. 
- Developing backend services and APIs using Node.js and PostgreSQL. 
- Supporting applications deployed within a shared AWS cloud infrastructure. 
- Using Amazon Q to improve development, troubleshooting, and code delivery workflows. 
- Collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable sports-betting experiences across mobile and web.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Supporting a Department of Defense digital engineering program by developing secure, AI-ready web applications that enhance knowledge management and mission decision support.

• Built and maintained two key platforms: a React.js knowledge management system and a Next.js 14 decision-support application designed for semantic search and future LLM integration.
• Integrated RESTful and GraphQL APIs using Node.js, TypeScript, and serverless functions to enable scalable data flow and intelligent document discovery.
• Automated CI/CD pipelines through AWS and Docker with comprehensive Jest and Cypress testing to ensure reliable, secure deployments.
• Collaborated with engineers, analysts, and cybersecurity teams to align architecture with Zero-Trust and DoD STIG standards while preparing systems for AI-driven capabilities.
• Built scalable and modular backend services using Nest.js with a clean layered architecture (controllers, services, modules) to support secure DoD applications
• Developed RESTful APIs in Nest.js using TypeScript, ensuring strong typing, maintainability, and clear data contracts between frontend and backend
• Implemented dependency injection and reusable providers in Nest.js to improve testability and reduce tight coupling across services
positions.insights: Skills: Next.js · React.js · Node.js · React Native

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description: I led the design and implementation of responsive front-end systems using React.js, Redux-Thunk, and React Hooks. Collaborating closely with back-end teams, I optimized application architecture, addressed performance bottlenecks, and ensured alignment with project goals to deliver high-quality user experiences.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: As a full-stack developer at Big Club Digital, I built scalable solutions using Node.js and jQuery while contributing to mobile game development with React Native. I enhanced Android app compliance by upgrading architecture, automated systems for increased efficiency, and delivered seamless user experiences for high-impact projects.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: At Ameren, I developed a Resource Management Tracker using the MEAN stack, improving managerial efficiency. I analyzed and resolved website issues, enhanced user-facing features, and converted complex data into actionable insights through detailed reporting, driving operational transparency and business outcomes.
